checks.evidence: Version 576 deployment appgdep_6ad98a7092448191914549573d1b8327 succeeded and the sampled migrated destination returned 200 with visible content at https://vii.spaplus.co/search/vacations/netanya-11266-7a5b7295.

All 2,340 generated publications are stored in app/data/legacy-search-page-publications.json and the exact committed artifact was deployed as version 576.
A fresh public browser load of the version 576 migrated page rendered the same H1, 15 results, breadcrumbs, recovered body and FAQ after deployment.
The exact release candidate passed all 1,457 automated tests including responsive shared-family coverage; the public desktop destination was independently inspected after deployment.
https://vii.spaplus.co/sitemap.xml returned 200 and its search-pages child sitemap contains the sampled ASCII canonical URL.
https://www.vii.co.il/s/netanya/11266 still returns 200 from the legacy origin because the signed-in Cloudflare account does not contain the vii.co.il DNS zone required for the custom-host cutover.
Sites version 574 remains available with exact version, deployment and commit identities recorded for rollback from version 576.

rollback.method: Redeploy Sites version 574 using version ID appgprj_6a71ccdca27481918bf04dd329d3eb21~appgver_a61c70631018819181debf4463b71a2e.

remaining_blockers: The live legacy domains vii.co.il and www.vii.co.il are still pending DNS changes; the current signed-in Cloudflare account does not own that zone, so public old-domain requests do not yet reach the deployed 301 inventory.

Historical coverage is bounded to 3,528 URLs from the current legacy sitemap, stored Search Console export and project catalog; a complete live Search Console or server-log export is unavailable for proving every historical URL beyond that union.
